question: What happens to even a wise person when nectar-tip and juice-essence burn?
premises: The nectar tip and juice essence are involved.
Even a wise person is affected.
inference: The verse warns that the burning process involving nectar and juice affects even the wise.
uncertainties: Whether dahyamāna modifies the wise person or the nectar/juice.
plain_english: Even a wise person is burning at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice.
